title: Direct delivery with 504 helpers for conditional κ = 0.001517760977820331
body:
This builds on my [#523](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/523), retaining its 112-port data controller and replacing its complex supplier with a 504-helper construction. The branch contains the #523 commit followed by one new commit for this increment.

Under the retained all-size compiler, common-label/mutable-basis realization, normalized Lemma A, restored-row, precision/tape and analytic-transfer interfaces,

$$
T(n)=O\!\left(n(\log n)^{1-\kappa}\right),\qquad
\kappa=\frac{1517760977820331}{10^{18}}
=0.001517760977820331.
$$

The saving is **4.10271% above #523** and **3.27687% above [#529](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/529)**. The complex supplier still binds. These percentages compare exponent savings, not practical runtime.

## Construction

Use the same coordinate partition in both target tetrahedra. Eight retired rows form an invertible source basis, allowing the coordinate centers to finish before the own-block terms are loaded directly into the target basis. Selected cross-block sums are delivered in two reads from existing face copies; 56 assembled packet sums are omitted.

The resulting word uses 504 helpers, with 72 compatible line gauges and 80 exact shared-donor pivots. A further 248 legal frame promotions combine delivery climbs without changing scalar coefficients, chronology or endpoints. Arbitrary helper dirt is handled by newly computed response compensation and explicit cleanup.

A new allocation assigns all 36,288 helper roles to whole idle physical families. Each complete invocation has 728 distinct active owners. Actual windows, orthogonal charts, spectators and all 7,968 remaining children are checked from the emitted program.

| Quantity | #523 | This increment |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Local data ports | 112 | 112 |
| Helpers | 560 | 504 |
| Local rank mass | 6,706 | 6,240 |
| Live families | 7,168 | 7,168 |
| Physical families | 7,738 | 7,682 |
| Global rank deficit | 2,560 | 2,560 |
| Certified complex saving | 0.001460074471110324279467 | 0.001520068077832496458155 |

Two exact moment engines, six bootstrap levels and all 47 strict outer inequalities give the displayed κ. The unchanged #493 bit supplier is repriced at `0.001565442026981656908596`; its physical operator remains a cited dependency.

Earlier contributions in #10, #18, #24, #32, #36, #104, #115, #130 and #144 concern batched boundaries, partial swaps, gauges, certified assembly and frame/cover constructions. These identify provenance rather than additive numerical gains. Dugongue's #505 remains credited for asynchronous scheduling.

The new direct-delivery architecture, compatible entrance selection, frame coalescing and physical allocation are contributed by **icekylinx**, with **GPT-6 Astra** assistance. Local review and submission packaging used **OpenAI Codex**. `NOTICE.md`, `SOURCES.json` and the retained ancestry preserve source-specific credits. #527 and #529 are numerical comparisons only.

## Proof and validation

The new package is `research/direct-delivery504-global/`:

- `proof/`: source-frontier identity, direct delivery, frame coalescing and whole-owner argument.
- `evidence/audit/EXACT-ASSEMBLY.json`: exact moments, bootstrap and strict margins.
- `EXPECTED.json`, `SOURCES.json`, `MANIFEST.json`: exact result and source/file bindings.
- `LOCAL-VALIDATION.json`: local incremental validation and verified dependency reuse.

```sh
python -B research/direct-delivery504-global/verify_fast.py --work /tmp/direct504-check
```

Local validation additionally used `--rebuild-local --delta-phases` on Python 3.14.8 with NumPy 2.3.5. It passed in 23.89 seconds: the selected factory and rational entrance relations were rebuilt, all 1,680 changed phase edges were checked, and the physical owner audit, fresh invoice and strict assembly passed. The 1,242 unchanged phase edges and 224 endpoint adapters reuse a cache checked against #523 byte-for-byte. Retained controller inputs also match the previous local validation.

Separate fresh checks passed for both emitted local orientations on all 728 columns, all seven residual wrappers, the fourteen exact source-frontier bases, and 112 delivery incidences. Thirteen local and five wrapper mutation controls were rejected. No predecessor cold replay or unchanged bit-operator reconstruction was repeated. The final prefix is 225 bits within the retained 512-bit allowance.

Final package manifest SHA256: `c1997405c5c0ccd9bdb0a30b0eb9a5a2dc7dc7ce7b59c6a83a2152b80f6410d1`.

Global template content SHA256: `ed47b5454779f7ad6b32ae492a13f8b5172b11c94c3877cbc5cc5d7a4c357738`.

Dedicated Python 3.11/3.14 CI performs supplier reconstruction and changed-edge verification. Remote CI is pending. Optional discovery files are excluded, and no PDF is generated. The historical joint-dual hash correction is inherited from #523.

This remains a finite conditional witness. The inherited all-size and analytic interfaces remain assumptions; no new Lean proof, unrestricted optimality or unconditional multiplication theorem is claimed.
